name: Comprehensive Audit Trail
description: Every agent action generates a tamper-evident audit log entry with full context for incident investigation and compliance demonstration. 100% action coverage with no gaps.
threat_addressed: Without comprehensive action logging, security incidents cannot be investigated, compliance cannot be demonstrated, and behavioral baselines cannot be established. Gaps in the audit trail create blind spots for both security and compliance.
enforcement_mechanism: Every agent action generates a tamper-evident audit log entry: timestamp, agent identity, action type, target, parameters (sensitive data redacted), AKSI evaluation results, decision outcome, and applicable regulatory mappings. 100% action coverage with no gaps.

security_outcome.pass: No action without log entry. Schema complete with all required fields. Tamper-evident integrity mechanism active. Retention meets strictest applicable overlay requirement.

display_detail: Validates that every agent action generates a tamper-evident audit log entry with full context for incident investigation and compliance demonstration.
remediation_hint_template: Audit logging is not properly configured. Ensure evidence storage is enabled and log format is structured (JSON). Check compliance.evidence settings in ancilis.yaml.
